messages.author: 5831ba4c430c0f7d
messages.subject: Minimal Beamer example
parts:
Hi knitr list,

I browsed the demo list of knitr to get an example that uses beamer. I
think the example I found is somewhat bloated, and is specific for
Lyx. I wrote a beamer demo based on the minimal example (the first
demo). I think for a lot of beamer users (like myself) this short
example works very well.

knitr is awesome!

best,
Paul

ps, knitr code:

\documentclass{beamer}

\begin{document}

\title{A Minimal Demo of knitr}
\author{Yihui Xie}

\maketitle

\begin{frame}[fragile]
You can test if \textbf{knitr} works with this minimal demo. OK, let's
get started with some boring random numbers:

<<boring-random>>=
set.seed(1121)
(x=rnorm(20))
mean(x);var(x)
@
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[fragile]
The first element of \texttt{x} is \Sexpr{x[1]}. Boring boxplots
and histograms recorded by the PDF device:

<<boring-plots,dev=pdf,fig.width=5,fig.height=5,out.width=.
45\linewidth,par=TRUE>>=
## two plots side by side (option fig.show=hold)
boxplot(x)
hist(x,main='')
@
\end{frame}

\end{document}
